dreamteamer.title: Tasks
dreamteamer.description: A concrete commitment, starting with a verb — `tasks`, each optionally owed by one `users` record (`assignee`; empty means the workspace's own person), with an absolute `due`, a free `lane` for the board, and an `item` backlink to the record it came out of. Ships the inbox (`/inbox`), the board (`/tasks/board`) and the by-person view (`/tasks/by-assignee`), and `working-with-tasks`, the procedure an agent follows to create, assign, triage and close one. Depends on the tags module, because `tasks.tags` points a writer at its script. Peers `projects` and `activities`: install the projects module and a task can hang off a plan rung, with the mirror stamped onto the plan; without it a write that sets either is refused, naming the missing collection.
